result.title: Policy Improvement-Guided Replay for Continual Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Continual reinforcement learning (CRL) requires models to acquire new capabilities while retaining performance on previous tasks. A stability-oriented perspective common in conventional continual learning emphasizes knowledge preservation and interference mitigation. Complementing this perspective, we revisit CRL for vision-language models through policy improvement, a fundamental principle of RL, to preserve acquired performance gains. Using the performance difference lemma, we characterize historical performance changes through the current policy's expected advantages on historical task distributions, motivating replay of historical prompts with the current policy. To allocate limited replay memory, we propose Contrastive Likelihood Replay (CoLiR), which contrasts likelihood gains on correct responses from the final task policy with likelihood reductions on incorrect responses from the initial policy. Our analysis links correct-response likelihood gains to reference-policy advantages under an idealized KL-regularized optimal update and provides an endogenous-reward interpretation for general policy updates. CoLiR estimates scores from finite training rollouts and cached log-likelihoods, selects prompts at task boundaries, and replays them uniformly during subsequent training, with KL regularization restricted to replayed prompts. Memory construction only requires a small amount of additional cross-policy scoring but no additional response generation. Across three Qwen3-VL model sizes on MRCL, CoLiR achieves the highest mean final accuracy and mean task accuracy among the compared methods while maintaining competitive new-task performance.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文从策略改进视角重审视觉语言模型的持续强化学习，用性能差引理将历史性能变化刻画为当前策略在历史任务分布上的期望优势，并提出 CoLiR：以正确响应似然上升与错误响应似然下降的对比来打分，选择历史 prompt 进行回放。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“用当前策略对历史 prompt 做打分筛选、再选择性回放”的机制，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与训练记忆分配提供借鉴线索，但研究目标是持续学习中的遗忘抑制而非 latent 推理状态，需进一步核查。
